messages:
grace (eng-rel): deploy-bot blocked the 2026.3.1 promotion to prod. It flagged `s3-inference-credentials.json` in staging as having an unexpected encryption header. link: https://deploybot.internal/r/2026.3.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Release checks failed: secret format mismatch for `secrets/s3-inference-credentials.json` (staging). Promotion paused. See logs: /var/log/deploybot/checks/2064129999.log

mike (infra): ahhh, we rotated the envelope key in the staging KMS last night. new key adds `x-encrypter: envelope-v2` header. older files still have `envelope-v1`.

sasha (runtime): runtime will error if creds file doesn't parse. the model loader expects `bucket` and `access_key` fields; if decrypt fails it crashes shard init. Not safe to promote.

anna (release): hold promotion to prod. We'll need either re-encrypt the staging secret with the new envelope key or patch the parser to accept v1/v2. Which is faster? Change window is 03:00-05:00 UTC.

mike (infra): re-encrypt is quick if we have plaintext. But we don't store plaintext. We can use the sops operator to rewrite the file using the new KMS; that'll require pulling from staging cluster and running `sops --encrypt --kms ...` locally. I can do it in ~25m.

kyle (oncall): if mike is doing that, we should pin the model image on the canary/dedicated pool to avoid accidental rollout using new creds. Suggest pin `model-serving:2026.2.8` for the canary group.

sasha (runtime): agree. Also add a fallback env var `MODEL_TAG_FALLBACK=model-serving:2026.2.8` in the release config so autoscaling doesn't pick latest.

mike (infra): plan: 1) pull `s3-inference-credentials.json` from staging pod 2) run `sops --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:...:envelope-v2` 3) apply to staging secret and redeploy canary 4) re-run deploybot checks 5) promote to prod during change window. I'll create a quick patch PR for the secret rewrite.

deploy-bot: Automated note: Deploy checks re-run required after secret update. Current status: blocked -> awaiting manual update.

anna (release): I'll update the release notes and change window. Add a note about the keystore rotation and the mitigation steps. Please add a short blurb for customers: "Minor credential rotation in staging delayed promotion; no customer impact expected."

jen (docs): I'll add a line to the release notes and the runbook about envelope header versions: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/secrets#envelope-headers

mike (infra): creating PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/3456 — includes sops command and apply job. applying to staging only now.

sasha (runtime): after mike patches the secret, I'll redeploy canary and smoke the model loader. If no crashes in 15 minutes, ready to re-run deploybot checks.

devops-oncall: ping me if the re-encrypt job needs a manual KMS approval. I'll be around for the change window.

grace (eng-rel): thanks. decision: hold prod promotion until PR merged and canary validated. update: adding `MODEL_TAG_FALLBACK` and pin as Sasha suggested. tagging relevant folks in the release notes. :white_check_mark:

mike (infra): PR merged, secret applied to staging, redeploy started. logs: ```
kubectl -n staging get secret s3-inference-credentials -o yaml | yq e '.data' -
sops --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/envelope-v2 secrets/s3-inference-credentials.json > reenc.json
kubectl apply -f reenc-secret.yaml
```

sasha (runtime): canary redeploy success. loader logs show decrypt ok and model shards initialized. no errors in the last 10m.

deploy-bot: Re-run checks triggered by user. All checks passed. Promotion to prod allowed but pending manual approval from release owner.

anna (release): approve promotion. scheduling promote at 03:15 UTC within change window. I'll update the release notes: link to PR 3456 and a short rollback plan.

grace (eng-rel): final note for the thread: add follow-up task to centralize envelope header compatibility or add a migration job next week. created ticket INFRA-789.

kyle (oncall): INFRA-789 or we could add a compatibility shim in the decrypt library. filing a small spike.

jen (docs): release notes updated and sent to customers list. small ops postmortem will follow in the morning.

grace (eng-rel): thanks everyone. closing thread once prod promotion completes. :rocket:
